# [TASK] Implement start-tunnel.sh and stop-tunnel.sh scripts for local gateway exposure

## Task
Write scripts to launch and stop a local Cloudflare Tunnel container that prints the public HTTPS URL in real-time and logs the connection.

## Scope
Includes `infrastructure/scripts/start-tunnel.sh` and `infrastructure/scripts/stop-tunnel.sh`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `start-tunnel.sh` starts a rootless `cloudflared` container tunneling to `http://localhost:8080` (or container network).
- [x] Extracts and displays the public `https://*.trycloudflare.com` URL on terminal output.
- [x] `stop-tunnel.sh` cleanly terminates the tunnel container.
- [x] Tested and verified against running local gateway.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 2

## Notes
Verified: `start-tunnel.sh` and `stop-tunnel.sh` in `infrastructure/scripts/`.
